intended_purpose: Controls an industrial robot arm in a factory cell.
foreseeable_use: Connected to a plant network; serviced on site through the CAN diagnostic port.
environment: Factory floor with restricted physical access; operated by trained staff.
expected_use_time: About 6 years, based on hardware durability.

remote_data_processing.rationale: The arm keeps working if the fleet server is unreachable, so its absence prevents no function (fictional example; section 8).

risks.description: Unauthorised access through the unauthenticated service port
risks.treatment: Require login on the service port

risks.description: CAN diagnostic port reachable in production builds
risks.treatment: Disable the port in production builds

risks.impact: Malicious code runs on the controller
risks.treatment: Signed A/B updates and secure boot
